The specific English language level required depends on your chosen programme, so please check the programme page in the HTW application portal for the exact requirements.

Most Master's programmes at HTW Berlin are offered as full-time on-campus programmes. Part-time study is also available as an option if you wish to attend fewer courses per semester and prolong your studies [Doc 5].
